title: New countywide water conservation ordinance
summary: The county's water conservation ordinance took effect March 1, committee staff said on September 2. It limits watering to three times a week, and a landscape architect said in August that irrigation plans will meet it. A separate measure, Bill 158, sets water conservation rules, including rules for declared water shortages.
